title: ridleyandra serratifolia

The therapeutic actions of Ridleyandra serratifolia are attributed to its antioxidant and anti-diabetic properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and improve insulin sensitivity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory and anti-diabetic activities.
